capabilities: Sync Bangumi collections into subject notes with status, rating, tags, comment, and cover fields
Push episode progress and collection status back to Bangumi from a note or a grid board
Write newly added or updated in-progress subjects into a Daily Note sync block
Generate a weekly On Air broadcast note grouped by weekday
Sync a single subject by URL, ID, or title search
extras: Only the Bangumi write-back feature is described as experimental; the plugin overall is desktop-first with limited mobile support (clipboard, token page, DNS fix). OAuth is not supported, so users must create a manual access token. Installation via BRAT is documented for beta builds.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull media collection data and watching progress from Bangumi into notes, or push episode progress back to Bangumi.

relations.evidence: Bangumi API: the foundation for Bangumi data access.
obsidian-weread-plugin: design reference for collection and reading sync plugins.

requires.name: Bangumi account with manual access token

summary: Syncs Bangumi media collections and episode progress into local notes, with a progress board, write-back, Daily Note blocks, and templates.
